summary.text: Mental Domain is a wisdom path secluded domain of heaven and earth recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu.

claims.text: Star Constellation Immortal Venerable inspects it in the deepest part of star array calculation formation. The secluded domain looks like a cage or a lantern. She had used it in Crazed Demon Cave to fight the other venerables. She placed it in the formation and used the formation to secretly absorb emotions. Negative emotions from Central Continent’s ten great ancient sects enter it, leaving only positive emotions toward Heavenly Court and those sects among countless lifeforms of Central Continent.

It needs to store emotions. The more it stores, the stronger the secluded domain becomes. Too much stored emotion reverses the effect. The Legends of Ren Zu say it is best to have calm Gu and fortitude Gu to suppress it. She has only calm Gu, so the amount it can store has a clear limit. When she created the formation she hid this from the two venerables, who could see only general information of the formation.
The secluded domain looks like a cage or a lantern.

In The Legends of Ren Zu, chapter five, section thirty-eight, Carefree Wisdom Heart takes out a cage and says she created Mental Domain, telling Ren Zu and Great Strength True Martial to place all their emotions in it. They do. The truthful floating ice then shows its original appearance, and they find calm Gu there.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable treats a secluded domain of heaven and earth as half a rank nine Immortal Gu and as a long term stable core for killer moves. He names Mental Domain as what Star Constellation Immortal Venerable has, set against Fang Yuan possibly having Refinement Sea and against his own Blood Sea.

She takes out the lantern-like secluded domain and swings it toward Fang Yuan. Countless emotions attack his mind and body. He is already prepared and uses several defensive killer moves, including calm and steady, which suppresses and eliminates his emotions quickly. She does not succeed in disturbing him.
Among secluded domains of heaven and earth, she possesses Book Mountain, Mental Domain, and the Door of Life and Death.

She shakes the lantern-like domain. The battlefield dims, it becomes like the only source of light, and a suction force extracts Fang Yuan’s accumulated emotions, then his wisdom path dao marks. Calm and steady and his other methods do not stop it. Reverse flow protection seal has no reaction: the extraction is not treated as an attack. In a few breaths he loses one hundred wisdom path dao marks. The core of the move is Mental Domain, and it can be considered a quasi-rank nine killer move, amplified by her wisdom path dao marks. Heavenly web protection veil’s defensive power is higher than that killer move.
